bayts.text: Toward others than us an oppressor and a Satan have turned their plot and striving, by (the grace of) Him Who led protection to me.
With Allah and the Chosen One I have become well pleased, and (Allah) has hurled Satan down, who has gone back hidden (in shame).
The faces of the Companions of the Select One confronted the enemies with expulsion and overthrow, as they persisted in repelling them.
I repelled the enemies through Allah and the Select One, the Prophet: one by one and two by two they turned their backs, keeping to flight.
I have dissociated myself, for the Face of Allah, from every idolater, (becoming) intimate friend and beloved of him who made life good.
The Everlasting (Al-Bāqī) has answered me, Who never turns any hired envious adversary against me, since He led to me the folding (of distances).
To Him Who has driven the enemies for ever, in disgrace, toward others than me, be praise: (He) Who led to me the object of my desire.
To my Lord, Who never lets any harm reach me, my gratitude and my praise, forsaking whatever holds a prohibition.
He is Allah, the All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), and He is the Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm): whoever turns to Him through the Select One remains for ever well-pleasing.
Muḥammad, the Chosen One: it has become clear that he is the chief of creation; whoever rejects him clings to error.
Prophet, Messenger – and his distinctions are manifest –: He Who never ceases to be Living (Al-Ḥayy) sent him to creation.
Through him the All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān) removed what the enemies aimed at: upon him the blessing of Allah, as much as he was generous and modest.
To Him (be praise) for repelling Satan, harm and trial toward others than us, and because serenity and the object of desire have yielded to me.
I have thanked Him Who struck down my enemy, turning Satan toward others than me, repelled in despair.
He Who guided me with His remembrance drives toward others than me the Accursed (Satan) and whoever seeks not understanding and knowledge.
The prowling of all the enemies is toward others than me: whoever refuses peace with me, through repentance, shall not attain right guidance.
The Everlasting (Al-Bāqī) has answered me, Who led every envious adversary, all together, toward others than me, and led my wishes to me: I am not seen (committing) transgression.
The best of intercessors has repelled every envious adversary for ever toward others than me; through him the Everlasting turns satiety and quenching toward me.
Toward others than the beloved of Allah, the beloved of His Messenger, inclines whoever has not accepted piety and Revelation.
It has become clear to me that the Last to Come (Muḥammad) is the Messenger of Him Who makes a secret everlasting for me and visits disgrace upon the enemies.
I have raised my praise to the Last to Come (Muḥammad) and his party, just as his Lord wholly erased the design of every envious adversary against me.
The reward for what was granted me in the year Daksash (1324 AH / 1906-07) is a reward from the Effacer of hardship (Al-Māḥī, Muḥammad), since he erased fear.
Allah drives every slanderer toward others, banished toward others than me, for ever, with no meeting.
He who guided me to his Lord (Muḥammad) has erased the design of every envious adversary against me: upon him the peace of Him Who, through him, led protection to me.
